headline: US Economy Adds 165,000 Jobs in October, Unemployment Rate Drops to 4.1%
summary: Nonfarm payrolls in the United States increased by 165,000 in October, comfortably surpassing consensus estimates of 65,000, while the national unemployment rate fell to 4.1%.
why: US nonfarm payroll data is a vital indicator for global financial markets and Fed monetary interest rate policy decisions.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Better-than-expected payroll growth pushed the US dollar higher against major currencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A strong upside surprise in nonfarm payroll creation strengthened expectations for sustained US economic resilience.
